bug_semantics: StorageClass parameters.pathPattern is expanded as an unsanitized Go template (PV name plus PVC metadata) and the result is used as folderName in filepath.Join(basePath, folderName). Because the template output may contain relative segments such as ../, Join resolves the volume path outside the configured node base directory, so a helper-pod create can place a PersistentVolume on an arbitrary host path (advisory example: {{ .PVC.Namespace }}/{{ .PVC.Name }}/../../../../../etc/new-dir). CWE-23; CVSS 9.9.
flaw_origin: The pathPattern feature added pathFromPattern() that Parse/Execute's the StorageClass parameter and returns buf.String() with no IsLocal/prefix/Clean-under-base check, then overwrites the previously underscore-joined folderName before the existing filepath.Join. That is the first write of attacker-controlled relative path elements into the volume path. The Join line itself predates the feature and was not a traversal sink while folderName was only PVName_PVC.Namespace_PVC.Name.
